name: Group Work Day
description: Split into groups and work through a shared to-do list, any group member checks items off, the projector shows every group's live progress. The template for lab days, stations, and project work. Hosted as-is it runs a zero-prep team challenge; swap in your own task list for a real work session.

intro.message:
GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups. Every group has the same checklist on their devices, check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group.
items: Introduce yourselves and agree on a team name
Find three things everyone in your group has in common (going to this school doesn't count)
Agree on one dream field trip, a destination and the reason
Plan a 30-second pitch for your field trip and pick who delivers it
Final check: mark this when every member has spoken at least twice

end.message: That's Group Work Day! Swap in your own tasks for any lab, stations, or project session.
